product.name: AI-Powered Video Creation Platform
product.description: Transforms raw screen recordings into polished product videos with AI-generated scripts, voiceovers, and visual enhancements.

product.name: Automated Step-by-Step Documentation Generator
product.description: Converts screen recordings into clear, branded step-by-step guides and help articles automatically.

product.name: AI Voiceover Service
product.description: Provides professional-grade AI voiceovers in over 35 languages with customizable pronunciation and accents.

product.name: AI-Powered Translation and Localization
product.description: Enables one-click translation of video scripts, captions, and documentation into 35+ languages with localized AI voiceovers.

product.name: Customizable Knowledge Base Hosting
product.description: Hosts videos and articles on a customizable, secure knowledge base with advanced search and access controls.

product.name: Slides to Video Converter
product.description: Converts static slide decks into narrated videos with AI-generated scripts and voiceovers.
